(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define objs (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 4)) (objects g 0)))
    (define (canon obj)
      (first (sort (map (lambda (cells) (format "~s" cells)) (all-transforms (obj-cells obj))) string<?)))
    (define keyed (map (lambda (o) (list (canon o) o)) objs))
    (define odd
      (let loop ((remaining keyed))
        (cond [(empty? remaining) #f]
              [(= (count-where (lambda (x) (equal? (first x) (first (first remaining)))) keyed) 1)
               (second (first remaining))]
              [else (loop (rest remaining))])))
    (if odd (paint-cells g (obj-cells odd) 8) g)))
